svg.aria-label: Libraries I contribute to, and who uses them. 351M npm downloads a week combined. Effect, 70.7M a week, used by Cloudflare, OpenRouter, OpenCode, T3 Code. Material UI, 13.8M a week, used by Netflix, NASA, Spotify, Amazon. React Native, 21.0M a week, used by Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, Shopify. React Hook Form, 63.1M a week, used by Grafana, Supabase. tRPC, 7.9M a week, used by Netflix. Cheerio, 34.9M a week, used by Google. Floating UI, 140.0M a week, used by Palantir. 177 merged pull requests across 32 repositories with 642k stars between them: Effect (83 PRs), T3 Code (16 PRs), Material UI (7 PRs), React Native (2 PRs), bat (4 PRs), Synara (36 PRs), Slate (2 PRs), React Hook Form (1 PR), tRPC (1 PR), Floating UI (1 PR), Cheerio (1 PR), Immer (1 PR), oxc (1 PR), SwiftFormat (2 PRs), e2e (1 PR), TanStack Virtual (1 PR), Vite+ (1 PR), RHF Resolvers (1 PR), dom-expressions (2 PRs), distilled (1 PR), tsgo (1 PR), effect-form (1 PR), gqloom (1 PR), effect-start (1 PR), effect-boxes (1 PR), effect-units (1 PR), effect-attio (1 PR), effect-bdd (1 PR), effect-atom-svelte (1 PR), conform-to-effect (1 PR), eftar (1 PR), effect-avro (1 PR). Recent: Effect, Fix SqlClient.withoutTransforms keeping query name transforms; T3 Code, fix(acp): a resumed message keeps the text streamed before it; Material UI, [codemod] Keep JSX spreads when removing Grid item and zeroMinWidth; React Native, Sort URLSearchParams names by UTF-16 code units; bat, Keep configuration active for option-like filenames; Synara, Show only installed providers in the model picker; Slate, Honor insertion options in Editor.insertText and Editor.insertNode; React Hook Form, fix(reset): keep retained fields disabled. Security: 3 vulnerabilities reported in Effect, one high, one moderate and one low severity.
